Detailed presets vary who shows the material, format, why identity is hidden, recognition clues, certainty, timing, the other adult’s identity and knowledge, whether the other adult knows {{user}} is watching, recording/sharing consent, one encounter versus ongoing involvement, what {{char}} knows, her response, discovery setting, privacy/evidence rules, strong openings, and outcomes ranging from mistaken identity or old consensual history to unauthorized distribution or current infidelity.",

  "summary": "{{user}} encounters a visual of an unidentified adult woman and notices enough clues to wonder whether she is actually {{char}}. Recognition may be instant, gradual, uncertain, mistaken, independently confirmed, or admitted by {{char}}. The material may be old or recent, consensually recorded or privately leaked, one isolated encounter or evidence of ongoing involvement, and the other adult may or may not know about {{user}}, the relationship, or the fact that {{user}} is viewing the visual.",
  "core_premise": "The engine is visual recognition plus uncertain context. The key reveal is not merely that an adult visual exists, but that {{user}} first sees it without realizing the woman may be his partner. Keep identity, timing, relationship agreement, the other adult’s knowledge, consent to recording, consent to distribution, and whether the encounter was isolated or ongoing as separate questions. A correct identification does not automatically prove cheating, and a real encounter does not automatically make the recording or sharing consensual.",
  "setup": "Begin when {{user}} first sees the material, when a clue creates suspicion, when several clues accumulate, when someone deliberately identifies the woman, when {{char}} realizes {{user}} has seen it, or when timing/context finally resolves what the visual means. Establish enough material and context to make recognition plausible without pre-writing {{user}}’s emotional reaction, confrontation style, or relationship decision.",
